title: Section 2: Design elements
slide_intent: Signal the move from brand definition to making visual materials. The familiar divider format helps a reader recognize a new working section.
strategic_value: Slack can organize a long reference book through consistent chapter cues while giving each chapter its own scope.
demonstration: The aubergine divider uses a white chapter heading and rule followed by a short explanation about applying Slack assets.
practical_value: Use the same chapter opener when the kind of decision changes, here from defining the brand to handling its design elements.

content_islands.name: Section heading
content_islands.spec: Place the numbered chapter heading at upper left and run a fine white rule below it.

content_islands.name: Chapter summary
content_islands.spec: Set the short introduction in a narrow left column. Leave the remaining aubergine field open.
